name: Minotaur
comment: His kit (the client has no Minotaur spells; these are generic ones his look, minotaur_monster_boss, animates): a quick XX_Smash 319298 (ability 1/2) and XX_Bull Charge 3202 (an 8 m charge, ×2 and a knockback on whom it runs into). The user (2026-10-30): he froze up close (the troll heavy hitter's 3.17 s ground smash, which he had, was recast every 2 s; enemies now wait out their cast animations) and should charge and have melee attacks. Rampage 319891 removed (2026-10-30): his motion set (82321) has no spin; its channel animation is channel_1, the bull rush dash, so he stood locked in the dash pose for its 4.5 s (user: froze on the attack after a charge).
